title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalam-u-Alaikum: I am being encountring alot of ghair muqalideen hazrat at the place where I live. And actually most of the time I have to lead the salat at our masjid. These salafi hazrat are very particular about 2rakat nafl before salat and emphasize on this so much that if someone do not pray then they ask him why.I just want to know what evidences we have in religion about that. Did prophet SAW was very punctual in that (means did he perform most of the time). In short I want how much emphsis religion put on this. wassalam 2357 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 1212 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it lawful to combine two prayers in journey? Question: Is it lawful to combine two prayers in journey? Answer ID: 1212 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 431/429=M) It is not allowed to combine prayers whether in journey or not except in Arafah and Muzdalifah while performing Hajj: لقولہ تعالی: ان الصلاۃ کانت علی المؤمنین کتاباً موقوتاً۔ ولقولہ علیہ السلام: من جمع بین صلاتین فی وقت واحد فقد أتی باباً من الکبائر و فی البدائع: انہ لایجوز الجمع بین فرضین فی وقت احدھما الا بعرفۃ و المزدلفۃ . ولایجوز الجمع بعذر السفر والمطر (بداءع: 1/327) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
